name: CAPTCHA After
description: Shows CAPTCHA after X unsuccessful submit attempts.
project_description: Show CAPTCHA protection on selected forms only after a configured number of submit attempts has been reached. CAPTCHA After extends the CAPTCHA module: instead of showing a challenge on every submission of a protected form, it hides the CAPTCHA element until Drupal's flood counters cross an admin-defined threshold, then reveals and enforces it. Thresholds can key on the visitor's hostname/IP, on the PHP session, or globally across all visitors, and can count either only invalid submissions (submit thresholds) or every submission of the form (flooding thresholds). Global defaults are set at /admin/config/people/captcha_after; per-form overrides are added to each CAPTCHA point on the CAPTCHA module's Form settings tab. A typical use is a login form where the CAPTCHA appears only after several failed logins, keeping the form frictionless for genuine users while still throttling automated abuse.
